title: Sum of Two Numbers
description: Write a function that takes two numbers and returns their sum.
input_format: Two numbers a and b (int or float)
solution:
def add_two_numbers(a, b):
    return a + b
explanation: Uses standard addition operator `+` to return the sum of two numerical values.

title: Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit
description: Convert a given temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit.
input_format: A single float/int representing temperature in Celsius
output_format: A float representing temperature in Fahrenheit

title: Check Even or Odd via Bitwise AND
description: Check if an integer is even or odd using the bitwise AND operator.
explanation: If the lowest bit (n & 1) is 1, the number is odd; otherwise, it is even.

title: Check Leap Year
description: Determine if a given year is a leap year.
solution:
def is_leap_year(year):
    return (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or (year % 400 == 0)
explanation: A year is leap if divisible by 4 and not 100, or divisible by 400.

title: Reverse an Integer
description: Reverse the digits of a given integer. Maintain the sign.
solution:
def reverse_integer(n):
    sign = -1 if n < 0 else 1
    rev = int(str(abs(n))[::-1])
    return sign * rev
explanation: Extract the sign, convert the absolute value to string, reverse using slicing `[::-1]`, convert back to int, and apply the sign.
time_complexity: O(D) where D is number of digits

title: Check Prime Number
description: Check whether a given integer n is prime.
explanation: Checks divisibility up to sqrt(n) skipping multiples of 2 and 3 (6k ± 1 rule).

title: Check Palindrome String
description: Check if a string is a palindrome, ignoring case and non-alphanumeric characters.
sample_input: "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"
explanation: Filters only alphanumeric characters in lowercase and checks if the list equals its reverse.

title: Find First Non-Repeating Character
description: Find the first character in a string that occurs only once. Return None if none exists.
explanation: Count frequencies using hash map in first pass, then iterate string to find the first character with frequency 1.

title: Remove Duplicates from List Preserving Order
description: Remove duplicate items from a list while keeping the original order of first appearance.
output_format: A list with unique elements in original order
explanation: Uses an auxiliary set for O(1) membership lookup while building the ordered result list.

title: Flatten a Nested List
description: Flatten an arbitrarily deep nested list into a single flat list.
explanation: Recursively traverses elements: extends results for list elements and appends scalar elements.
time_complexity: O(N) where N is total scalar elements
space_complexity: O(D + N) for recursion stack and output list

title: Two Sum (Hash Map Solution)
description: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.
explanation: Stores element indices in a hash map to look up the complement `target - num` in O(1) time.

title: Maximum Subarray Sum (Kadane's Algorithm)
description: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum and return its sum.
explanation: Kadane's algorithm: at each step, decide whether to start a new subarray or extend the existing one.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
explanation: Sliding window technique maintaining the last seen index of each character to shift the left boundary.
space_complexity: O(min(N, M)) where M is character set size

title: Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string s containing '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid.
explanation: Use a stack to push opening brackets and pop matching opening brackets when closing brackets are encountered.

title: LRU Cache Implementation
description: Design a data structure that follows the constraints of a Least Recently Used (LRU) cache with O(1) get and put operations.
input_format: Method calls get(key) and put(key, value)
explanation: Utilizes OrderedDict to achieve O(1) key lookups and O(1) eviction of least recently used items.
